text: {"status":"answered","answer":"Under the Overdraft Policy v3.0 (effective 1 January 2026), the overdraft fee is $29 per item for items paid through Courtesy Pay, capped at a maximum of 3 items per business day. You won't be charged an overdraft fee if your account is overdrawn by $25.00 or less at the end of the business day, and there's no fee for items Harbor returns unpaid (a returned item/NSF fee of $27.00 per item applies instead, per the Schedule of Fees and Charges: Retail Accounts, 2026). Note this fee was reduced from $32 under the previous version 2.0.","cited_chunk_ids":["overdraft_policy_v3::layout::B_structure::0004","overdraft_policy_v3::layout::B_structure::0009","fee_schedule_2026::layout::B_structure::0001"],"reason":"The current Overdraft Policy v3 states the per-item fee and its conditions directly."}
